\begin{tabular}{p{2.6cm}p{3.6cm}p{10.4cm}}

Setting & The guide & Evidence \\
\hline
Evaluation guidance & Give the rubric or the reference answer & Raised agreement in 13 of 15 model-dataset combinations (12 after correction), by 0.095 to 0.336 QWK, for 1.2 to 1.8 times the cost per grade \\[2pt]
Grading instruction & Ask for partial credit & Raised code agreement for 2 of 5 models, by 0.06 to 0.11 QWK, for 53 to 60 extra input tokens (5 to 9\% of the cost); on Mohler and SemEval every change lay within $\pm0.05$ \\[2pt]
Reasoning & Off & Turning it on raised agreement in 6 of 20 combinations (3 after correction), made grades less consistent in 17, and multiplied the output tokens by 9 to 925 \\[2pt]
Scope & One question per call & The whole exam in one call never raised agreement, lowered it for 2 of 3 models, and changed the cost per question by $-$6\% to $+$9\% \\[2pt]
Decomposition & One holistic score & Scoring per criterion raised agreement in 1 of 6 comparisons, at 1.3 to 3.1 times the cost per answer \\[2pt]
Conversation & A clean conversation per answer & In one shared conversation per exam, grades fell by 0.010 to 0.027 of the scale, and answer order moved them by 8 to 10\% of the marks \\[2pt]
\hline
